source_photos.author: Windmemories

observable_structure.observed: Tall brick entrance tower; round-arched stone door opening, above it three tall windows with central arch and flanking rectangular tops, above them three narrow rectangular openings. Do not substitute a flat uniform window grid.
observable_structure.uncertainty: Exact reveals, opening sill heights and stone thickness await calibrated multi-point measurement; single-view perspective is not true width/height.

observable_structure.observed: Two visible tiers of strongly swept upturned eaves with corner curvature, exposed closely spaced rafter ends and bracket/beam structure. Upper tier is taller; tiled roof ridges and tip shapes visible.
observable_structure.uncertainty: Rear ridge/intersection profile and full hidden roof pitch not determined; no invented dome.

observable_structure.observed: Lower eaved wings flank the tower. Near left wing has a round window above a tall arched window/door, large red freestanding columns and a decorated horizontal beam/bracket band. A higher setback roof and upper rectangular window strip are visible behind the low eave.
observable_structure.uncertainty: Far right wing partly tree-hidden; cannot infer exact complete side/back opening count by symmetry alone.

observable_structure.observed: Main central doorway reached by visible steps; stone guardians flank the approach, planted beds and street lamps obscure portions of base.2024 also shows a metal-railed side access route.
observable_structure.uncertainty: No surveyed ground heights, exact stair/ramp dimensions or inaccessible back entry.

2014: Large red cross visible below the three narrow upper tower windows.
Gold 上帝爱世人 lettering is below the middle windows above a pale 鸿德堂 tablet.
Daylight material reference; brick is grey/brown and timber/columns red, with greenish/blue bracket paint.
2024: The same red cross is not visible at the clear corresponding facade position; cannot silently retain2014 cross as verified2024.
Gold lettering appears moved beneath upper windows; lower tablet is blue with gold border/lettering.
Strong warm wall and cyan bracket illumination; night image colors must not be treated as daylight material albedo.
Seasonal Christmas tree obscures part of entrance; never bake it into building geometry/texture.
epoch_differences.policy: Choose an explicit epoch before modeling signs/cross and retain evidence of differences; use2014 only to resolve structure/daylight material with declared later alterations.
